contains: Green Valley of Russian River Valley

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A huge Sonoma County AVA of about 480,000 acres along the Pacific coast and some inland areas. It is cool and rainy compared with the rest of the county, with so many microclimates that smaller coastal AVAs such as Fort Ross-Seaview and West Sonoma Coast were carved from it.
